description.zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en:
This parameter is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The parameter value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

The parameter value consists of ASCII characters with a maximum length of 64 characters. Non-ASCII characters are not allowed.
The custom description of the endpoint.

description.zh: 实例的Endpoint ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints查询。
description.en: The endpoint ID of the instance. You can call DescribeDBInstanceEndpoints to query the endpoint ID.
The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.
The information list of endpoint nodes.
The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID.

description.zh:
节点ID。

可以通过以下方式查询节点ID：
- 在RDS控制台的实例详情页下方的实例拓扑图中查看节点ID。
- 调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute查询节点ID。
description.en:
The node ID.

You can query the node ID by using the following methods:
- View the node ID in the instance topology diagram at the bottom of the instance details page in the ApsaraDB RDS console.
- Call DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to query the node ID.

description.zh:
节点当前权重取值，按照该取值分配读流量。

取值范围：0～100
description.en:
The current weight value of the node. Read traffic is distributed based on this value.

Valid values: 0 to 100.

title.en: Modify the endpoint weight information of an instance
